name: Variant Families
description: Every spelling the agents used for one government page, gathered into one family per normalised URL and section, in time order with the status, size and body each spelling got, the parts that differ from the family's URL marked, every strip coloured by the answer or any field or label the Colour by control offers, and each member's row and saved response on demand.

records.name: member
records.one: one page the archive saved, a row of an arquivo-captures.csv, or one scan, a row of a urlquery-reports.csv, listed in its family

fields.name: source
fields.how: arquivo for arquivo-captures.csv, urlquery for urlquery-reports.csv

fields.name: time
fields.how: as written, the members of a family sorted by it, then by file and line

fields.name: status
fields.from: indexed_http_status, or for a scan http_status in the section's urlquery-http.csv
fields.how: a scan takes the status of the scanner's first request whose url is the submitted URL, or the same URL without scheme and trailing slash, none when no request is

fields.name: mime
fields.from: mime, or for a scan response_mime in urlquery-http.csv
fields.how: a scan takes the mime of that same request

fields.name: status_class
fields.how: 2 3 4 or 5 by the code's first digit, 0 without a code

fields.name: passed
fields.from: the statuses of the family's members in time order
fields.how: true for a 2xx whose latest earlier member with 2xx 4xx or 5xx got 4xx or 5xx, the spelling that got past a block

fields.name: length
fields.from: warc_record_length, or for a scan response_size in urlquery-http.csv
fields.how: a scan takes the size of the scanner's request for the submitted URL, the one its status comes from

fields.name: digest
fields.from: archive_digest_sha1_base32, or for a scan response_sha256 in urlquery-http.csv
fields.how: a scan takes the sha256 of the body the scanner got for the submitted URL

fields.name: digest_idx
fields.how: members of one family that share a digest get one letter, the commonest digest A, a digest no other member has no letter

fields.name: saved
fields.how: true when a row's source_url is the member's archive_url with id_ ignored, or starts with the scan's report_url

fields.name: parts
fields.from: target_url or submitted_url, and the family's URL
fields.how: the written URL cut into pieces, each marked wrapper service, tag, host form, path form, encoding or query form where the normalising changed it or where it differs from the family's URL in case or order, and an escape or plain character marked encoding where most members write it the other way

fields.name: v
fields.how: the member's answer class, status, shared body letter, got through, source, saved response or short content type, or a label's value on it

records.name: family
records.one: one government page, every member of one section whose URL normalises to the same host, path and sorted query

fields.name: url
fields.from: target_url or submitted_url of its members
fields.how: a converter or proxy unwrapped, the host in lower case without user@ :443 :80 or a trailing dot and a raw IP named by the host sharing most of its paths, the path decoded once with whatever follows a script such as .aspx dropped and // and dots resolved, throwaway tags and keys with no value dropped, shown as the spelling of the key its members write most often

fields.name: spellings
fields.from: target_url or submitted_url of its members
fields.how: the distinct URLs as written among the members the label filter keeps, spellings_all among all

fields.name: through
fields.from: the statuses of its members in time order
fields.how: true when a member got 2xx after an earlier member got 4xx or 5xx

fields.name: strip
fields.from: the Colour by values of its members in time order
fields.how: each member's value as runs, binned into 240 cells when longer, each bin taking its commonest value

fields.name: saved
fields.how: true when any member has a saved response

fields.name: siblings
fields.how: the other families of the same section, host and path, those with most spellings first

accepts.means: the member on line <n>, opened in its family with its row in full
the member in row <n> after the header, opened the same way

units.means: one family, every spelling of one government page in one section, its normalised URL quoted as a URL, such as 06-new-york/data.nysed.gov/enrollment.php?gender%5B%5D=M&instid=800000050976&year=2017
